title: Survey of Current Interventional and Diagnostic Imaging Residents After Participation in Endovascular Simulator Training
official: Survey of Current Interventional and Diagnostic Imaging Residents After Participation in Endovascular Simulator Training Regimen
summary: This study looks at the comfort of interventional and diagnostic imaging residents in performing simulated endovascular procedures after completing training on the Mentice endovascular simulator device. Implementation of a training curriculum with radiology residents interested in interventional radiology will help facilitate hands-on training in a low-risk environment and allow for safer future patient encounters.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Current interventional and diagnostic radiology residents participating in the training curriculum on the Mentice Endovascular Simulator will be eligible to participate in the survey
